id: Perbaikan isolasi sesi login Google, tambah multi-akun Google, logout, dan login Spotify menggunakan Google agar selalu segar tanpa otomatis masuk akun lama.
Pengerasan keamanan menyeluruh: enkripsi sesi akun Android Keystore AES-256-GCM, verifikasi SHA-256 & tanda tangan APK untuk pembaruan in-app.
Toggle "Simpan juga ke YouTube Music" saat impor playlist Spotify — tetap bisa impor secara lokal meski belum login Google.
en: Fixed WebView session isolation for Google sign-in, adding multiple Google accounts, logout, and Spotify login with Google so stale accounts never auto-login.
Comprehensive security hardening: Android Keystore AES-256-GCM account session encryption plus SHA-256 and APK signature verification for in-app updates.
"Also save to YouTube Music" toggle when importing Spotify playlists — import locally even without signing in to Google.
